items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: I think I had up to about some great Lee Morgan licks up until the 60s.

ctx.x: Do you feel like you developed your own thing on the trumpet?

No not really. I think I had up to about some great Lee Morgan licks up until the 60s. But you know trumpet was a way of staying in music and making some money, but I really didn’t have that fire like Pat has or Joe has for the instrument. Because when writing took over, I really didn’t, you know I’ve got a trumpet back there somewhere but you know it’s not my passion. I like playing it, it’s fun. But I really didn’t have that fire to continue on like Pat did and really get into it. Because again, the writing…
So you became a writer, you’re dependent on whether people play your music.
